title: Suppression of Universal Errors in DFS-Encoded Superconducting Geometric Logical \emph{T} Gate
summary: High-fidelity logical \emph{T}-gate realization constitutes a core prerequisite for large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computing. However, conventional magic state distillation requires massive physical qubit overhead across successive distillation rounds, alongside sophisticated measurement and feedback control, thereby inducing considerable spatial and temporal resource consumption.
